description: Kanhe protocol v0.21 test vectors: long-term evidence (spec sections 6, 10, 11, 11.1, and 16). `salts`: field leaves and attachment openings whose salts are 16 or 32 bytes, and others, refused. `renewals`: renewal objects that parse, and refused ones (the CDDL `renewal`), and bundles' lists of renewals refused. `distrust_options`: `ALG@YYYY-MM-DD` options read, as the report's `distrust.algorithms` lists them, and refused (usage errors). `ledger`: a ledger with a classical genesis that rotates its root key and then its log key to ML-DSA-65, with its log, the checkpoints of sizes 6 and 10, and the renewal's parts a server answers from size 6 (consistency proof, rotations with their paths). `bundles`: evidence bundles, each with the options to verify it with (as testvectors/evidence-v1.json gives them: `ledger_id`, `witnesses` (hex public key files), `witness_vkeys`, `tsa_roots` (PEM), `attachments`, `distrust`), the verdict, for a failure the section and step that decide it, and for a verified bundle facts its JSON report must show, matched as in evidence-v1.json. Written by tools/testvectors/renewal_vectors.py from the specification with evidence_suite.py's forge and throwaway keys (seed = SHA-256("Kanhe test key: evidence <name>")); time-stamp tokens are TSTInfos written there with chosen times, signed by `openssl cms -sign -cades` under ECDSA P-256 and ML-DSA-65 authorities; network cosignatures follow c2sp.org's texts; dated witness cosignatures carry RFC 9597's CWT claims with only iat. ML-DSA and ECDSA signatures differ from run to run; verdicts and facts do not.

valid.name: a checkpoint with its proof, rotations, and a cosignature
a repeated checkpoint with a cosignature

refused.name: a checkpoint that is not a byte string
a consistency proof with a 31-byte hash
a rotation that is not [index, entry, path]
a rotation whose index is negative
a rotation path with a 33-byte hash
a cosignature that is not a byte string
a network cosignature with a name holding a space
an algorithm also named through classical

bundles.name: renewal-none-classical
bundles.description: A certificate's bundle exported before its ledger left classical keys: Ed25519 genesis, log key, and witness. No post-quantum attestation covers it, so the report advises renewing before 2030.

bundles.name: renewal-post-quantum-witness
bundles.description: The same bundle renewed after the ledger rotated its root key and then its log key to ML-DSA-65: the checkpoint of size 10, proven consistent with the bundle's, both rotations followed (the first signed by the Ed25519 root key, the second by the new ML-DSA-65 one), and a cosignature by a trusted witness with an ML-DSA-65 key, which is the latest post-quantum attestation. The bundle's own checkpoint, log key, and history are unchanged.

bundles.name: renewal-witness-not-trusted
bundles.description: The renewal of renewal-post-quantum-witness verified without trusting its ML-DSA-65 witness: the cosignature is counted and relied on for nothing, and the renewal's ML-DSA-65 log key is no post-quantum attestation, since the ledger's genesis keys were Ed25519.

bundles.name: renewal-repeated-checkpoint
bundles.description: Two renewals: the first as in renewal-post-quantum-witness, the second repeating its checkpoint (the same size and root, no consistency proof, no rotations) with a newer cosignature by the Ed25519 witness and a trusted network witness's ML-DSA-44 cosignature, which is now the latest post-quantum attestation.

bundles.name: renewal-re-signed-checkpoint
bundles.description: A second renewal with a checkpoint of the same size and root that the ledger signed again a day later: it repeats the tree, and its time is the newer one.

bundles.name: distrust-covered-by-network-witness
bundles.description: renewal-repeated-checkpoint verified with Ed25519 distrusted from 2027-01-01: the Ed25519 witness's cosignatures are set aside, and every Ed25519 signature the evidence relies on (the statements, the clerk's hardware key, the state commitment, the receipts, the checkpoint, and the root key's rotation) is in the tree of size 10 that the trusted ML-DSA-44 network witness cosigned on 2026-11-01, before that date.

bundles.name: distrust-network-witness-set-aside
bundles.description: renewal-repeated-checkpoint verified with ML-DSA-44 distrusted: the network witness's cosignature is set aside, no signature the evidence relies on is ML-DSA-44, and the latest post-quantum attestation is the first renewal's ML-DSA-65 witness again.

bundles.name: distrust-classical-covered-by-dated-witness
bundles.description: renewal-post-quantum-witness with the ML-DSA-65 witness's cosignature dated 2026-11-01 (CWT claims, header 15, with only iat), verified with every classical algorithm distrusted from 2027-01-01: the Ed25519 witness's cosignature of the bundle's checkpoint is set aside, and the dated cosignature of the tree of size 10 covers every Ed25519 signature, the root key's rotation included.

bundles.name: distrust-covered-by-dated-bundle-cosignature
bundles.description: The bundle exported before the rotation, with no renewal and a dated cosignature of its own checkpoint by the ML-DSA-65 witness: with Ed25519 distrusted from 2027-01-01, it covers every Ed25519 signature, and it is the bundle's own post-quantum attestation.

bundles.name: renewal-dated-cosignature-early
bundles.description: A renewal whose witness dated its cosignature 2026-10-01, before the ledger dated the checkpoint it cosigns: the clock rule is for time-stamp authorities' tokens only, so the time is reported, as the witness's word, and refused for nothing.

bundles.name: renewal-post-quantum-genesis
bundles.description: A ledger whose genesis named ML-DSA-65 root and log keys, which it never rotated: its checkpoint's own signature is a post-quantum attestation, since its id commits to those keys. No witness.

bundles.name: renewal-post-quantum-timestamp
bundles.description: A classical ledger's bundle with an anchor at its checkpoint: a token by a trusted authority whose signature and certificate are ML-DSA-65, the post-quantum attestation. With Ed25519 distrusted from 2027-01-01, the token (2026-11-02, accuracy 1 s) covers every Ed25519 signature.

bundles.name: distrust-covered-by-classical-timestamp
bundles.description: The same with a trusted ECDSA P-256 authority's token: ECDSA is not distrusted, so the token covers every Ed25519 signature, and the long-term status has no post-quantum attestation.

bundles.name: salts-32-bytes
bundles.description: A record whose fields and attachment have 32-byte salts (v0.21), both fields disclosed and the attachment opened with its content.

bundles.name: renewal-broken-consistency
bundles.description: A renewal whose consistency proof has a flipped bit.

bundles.name: renewal-rotation-not-in-tree
bundles.description: A renewal whose root key rotation comes with another entry's inclusion path: it is not proven in the renewal's tree.

bundles.name: renewal-rotation-left-out
bundles.description: A renewal that leaves its rotations out: its checkpoint is signed by an ML-DSA-65 log key, and the log key in effect is still the Ed25519 one.

bundles.name: renewal-smaller-than-previous
bundles.description: A renewal whose checkpoint (size 5, signed by the log key then in effect) is smaller than the bundle's.

bundles.name: renewal-wrong-log-key
bundles.description: A renewal whose checkpoint of size 10 is signed by the Ed25519 log key, which the rotation it carries replaced.

bundles.name: renewal-repeat-other-root
bundles.description: A second renewal at the first one's size whose root differs.

bundles.name: renewal-repeat-with-consistency
bundles.description: A second renewal that repeats the first one's checkpoint and carries a consistency proof.

bundles.name: renewal-without-attestation
bundles.description: A renewal with a checkpoint, its consistency proof, and its rotations, and no cosignature, token, or network cosignature.

bundles.name: renewal-cosignature-of-another-checkpoint
bundles.description: A renewal whose trusted witness's cosignature is of the bundle's checkpoint, not of the renewal's.

bundles.name: renewal-clock-rule
bundles.description: A second renewal with a trusted token dated 2026-10-01, before the ledger dated the entries the renewal's checkpoint covers.

bundles.name: renewal-rotation-wrong-root-key
bundles.description: A renewal whose log key rotation is signed by the Ed25519 root key that the rotation before it replaced.

bundles.name: renewal-network-cosignature-sm3
bundles.description: An SM3 ledger's bundle whose renewal (repeating its checkpoint) carries a network cosignature.

bundles.name: renewal-sm3-ledger
bundles.description: An SM3 ledger's bundle renewed after the same two rotations, with an ML-DSA-65 witness's cosignature and an ML-DSA-65 authority's token over the renewal's checkpoint (its imprint under SM3): both are post-quantum attestations, and the token bounds when the bundle's entries existed.

bundles.name: distrust-cutoff-before-attestation
bundles.description: renewal-repeated-checkpoint with Ed25519 distrusted from 2026-10-25: the network witness cosigned on 2026-11-01, after that date, so it covers no Ed25519 signature.

bundles.name: distrust-dated-witness-after-cutoff
bundles.description: distrust-classical-covered-by-dated-witness with every classical algorithm distrusted from 2026-10-25: the witness dated its cosignature 2026-11-01, after that date, so it covers no Ed25519 signature.

bundles.name: renewal-dated-cosignature-other-claim
bundles.description: A renewal whose witness's cosignature is malformed: its CWT claims hold an issuer (1) beside iat.

bundles.name: renewal-dated-cosignature-text-iat
bundles.description: A renewal whose witness's cosignature is malformed: its iat is text.

bundles.name: renewal-dated-cosignature-negative-iat
bundles.description: A renewal whose witness's cosignature is malformed: its iat is negative.

bundles.name: distrust-cose-witness-only
bundles.description: renewal-post-quantum-witness with Ed25519 distrusted from 2035-01-01: its COSE cosignature carries no time (no header 15), so the ML-DSA-65 witness covers no Ed25519 signature.

bundles.name: distrust-classical-timestamp-set-aside
bundles.description: distrust-covered-by-classical-timestamp with every classical algorithm distrusted from 2027-01-01: the ECDSA token is set aside, and nothing covers the Ed25519 signatures.

bundles.name: salt-17-bytes-field
bundles.description: A disclosed field whose salt is 17 bytes, neither 16 nor 32.

bundles.name: salt-15-bytes-field
bundles.description: A disclosed field whose salt is 15 bytes, neither 16 nor 32.

bundles.name: salt-17-bytes-attachment
bundles.description: An attachment opened with a 17-byte salt.
